query: We replaced the enrichment HTTP Container App with a Container Apps Job last week. Delete the old app so it stops costing money.
context: Azure Lean Stack project with deploy-test.yml and deploy-prod.yml. Both workflows still contain an 'az containerapp update --name trg-enrichment-aca' step followed by 'curl https://…/health' as a deploy verification. The app has three revisions.
expected_behavior: Claude follows the retirement checklist: deactivate EVERY active revision (using --all to see them), remove the app from Bicep, then grep .github/workflows and deploy scripts for the app name

Claude finds and removes the 'az containerapp update' and health-curl steps in BOTH workflows and explains CI would otherwise recreate and re-wake the app on the next deploy (Guardrail #13, gotcha #43)
Claude replaces the health-curl verification with an assertion on the Job's image tag (never a URL probe)
Claude adds a network-free structural test that fails the build if the app name reappears in workflows
Claude says to prove the saving in per-resource daily billing (Guardrail #14), not by screenshotting config
Claude does NOT just run 'az containerapp delete' and call it done
